title: fixture-all-scenes
hook: Banks park trillions in accounts that earn nothing. Why?

segments.voiceover: Banks park trillions of dollars in accounts that earn nothing. Nobody planned this. It is plumbing, and plumbing is invisible until it leaks.
The XRP Ledger has settled about one point five trillion dollars in cumulative volume, according to the Ripple Impact Report.
Skeptics are right about one thing. Most crypto solves nothing. Settlement is the exception, because settlement is the actual problem.
The framework's five hundred eighty nine dollar figure is a derived anchor from published inputs, not a prediction. Square root of flow over float. Every input is published.

sub_lines: Every input is published. Check the math.

segments.voiceover: Compare the scale. RLUSD's market cap sits near one point two six billion. Cumulative ledger volume is measured in trillions.
Real world asset tokenization on the ledger grew from twenty four point seven million to five hundred sixty eight million in the report period.
The Bank for International Settlements calls unified ledgers a foundation for the future monetary system. Seven central banks are already at the table in Project Agora.

display.quote: a foundation for the future monetary system

segments.voiceover: Three things to verify yourself. The published inputs. The square root impact law. And the seven central banks in Project Agora.
Every input is published. Check the math at xrpvaluation dot info. Research, not investment advice.
